gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histological diagnosis of MGMT promoter methylated, IDH wild type (WT) GBM with consistent local molecular pathology

candidate_evidence.quote: to compare the cannabinoid Nabiximols with placebo in patients with recurrent MGMT methylated glioblastoma (GBM) treated with temozolomide (TMZ).
To establish whether the addition of cannabinoids (Nabiximols) to standard TMZ treatment improves overall survival time (OS)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: First recurrence of GBM planned for systemic treatment as determined by local Multidisciplinary Team (MDT)

role_evidence.quote: Nabiximols up to 12 oromucosal sprays per day up to a maximum of 6 cycles; self titrated over days 1-14 in cycle 1.
To establish whether the addition of cannabinoids (Nabiximols) to standard TMZ treatment improves overall survival time (OS) in MGMT methylated recurrent GBM

flag.reason: Nabiximols split into THC and CBD components per FDC rule; THC moiety named as dronabinol (delta-9-THC). Role combination because two FDC components plus TMZ; check whether monotherapy role intended for single investigational product.
